To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the synthesis of nanoparticles of samarium(II) oxide, gadolinium(II) oxide and iron(II) oxide was successfully carried out by the polyol method and the nanoparticles were successfully embedded into polydopamine spheres.

the polyol synthesis method is more effective than the calcination method for synthesizing Sm2O3, Gd2O 3 and Fe3O4 nanosized particles and that the polydopamine coating method is more effective for embedding the nanosized particles in the polydop amine sphere than the silica coating method.
the polydopamine spheres were successfully embedded with three different nanoparticles of Sm2O 3, Gd2O 3 and Fe3O4.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the polyol solvent is the most suitable method for the synthesis of the nanoparticles and the embedding of the nanoparticles into polydopamine is a simple and efficient way to make them more stable, dispersible, compatible, and nonaggregate so as to fully utilize their features in the biomedical applications.
the nanoparticles can be dispersed by polydopamine and silica coating.
the polyol solvent synthesis of Sm2O 3 and Gd 2O3 nanoparticles and the polydopamine embedding are the most promising methods for biomedical applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the polydopamine embedding of nanoparticles can be a good method to prepare the nanoparticles with high dispersibility and compatibility in biomedical applications.
the polydopamine coating is more effective in improving the dispersibility of nanoparticles than silica coating and it can be a potential material to be applied in biomedical applications.
the nanoparticles with different features could be prepared in a simple and controllable manner by the polyol method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nanoparticles of Sm2O 3 and Gd 2O 3 can be embedded into polydopamine spheres and the Fe3O4 nanoparticle can be coated by polydopamine.
the polydopamine embedding method is more suitable than coating with silica to make nanoparticles dispersible in water.
the embedding of nanoparticles in polydopamines is a promising method to make nanoparticles biocompatible and to avoid agglomeration.
